# Copilot Instructions

## General Guidelines
- Before making code changes, explain each proposed file and change clearly, including its purpose and why it is needed; do not create unfamiliar files without the user's understanding and agreement.

## Project Guidelines
- In this ATM application, AccountNumber is currently modeled as an int in the C# Customer class, so database examples should use an integer account-number type unless discussing a deliberate schema redesign.
- Organize the ATM application modularly with clear separation of concerns before adding database hashing and persistence.
